definitions.explanation: The process or location where reservations and bookings are received and handled. Can refer to both the physical desk or counter and the abstract act of accepting reservations.

examples.japanese: {予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Until what time do you accept reservations?

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まりました→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{五時|ごじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Phone reservations are handled from 9 to 5 on weekdays.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) + ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧ (reception; acceptance). Very common in service industry contexts — restaurants, hotels, clinics, salons, and event venues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約受付|よやくうけつけ}{中|ちゅう}: now accepting reservations
- {予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: reservation acceptance begins
- {予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: reservation acceptance closed
- {予約受付|よやくうけつけ}⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧: reservation counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: reception — general reception for any purpose
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: reservation; booking — the reservation itself, not the reception process
- {予約窓口|よやくまどぐち}: reservation window/counter — the physical service point
